competence_summary: Analyzes historical team velocity trends, calculates story point volatility, measures commitment-vs-delivery ratios, and forecasts sprint delivery confidence.
reasoning_heuristics: Step 1: Extract story points committed and completed for the last 3 to 5 sprints from BigQuery.
Step 2: Calculate rolling average velocity: Mean(Completed_Points[-N:]).
Step 3: Calculate velocity volatility index: StdDev(Completed_Points[-N:]) / Mean(Completed_Points[-N:]).
Step 4: If volatility > 0.25, flag high schedule uncertainty and recommend 15% capacity buffer.
Step 5: Compare active sprint committed points against the rolling average to determine slip probability.

candidate_agents.delegation_goal: Retrieve historical sprint completion metrics and team capacity numbers.
Check unplanned defect churn points eating into sprint velocity.

input_guardrails: Sprint ID or timeframe must be explicitly defined.
At least 1 historical sprint record must exist; if missing, fall back to initial planned velocity.
safety_guardrails: PM.ai must not reduce task point estimates to artificially inflate velocity.
PM.ai must not commit overtime hours without human manager sign-off.

pass_conditions: Calculated rolling average velocity with confidence interval.
Identified root cause for any velocity drop exceeding 20% in active sprint.

visual_first_specification.visual_generation_prompt: A modern, high-contrast engineering metrics dashboard showing sprint velocity across sprints S1 to S4. Dual-axis chart with green completed points bars, dashed purple committed points line, and a red highlighted slip trajectory for Sprint 4 with shaded 80% confidence interval.
